text: Implemented matrix-free rectangular block operators in linalg; direct-sum studies with block-diagonal X and R; independent, hub, same-row, and pairwise row compilation; separate BlockDesign; nominal RowGeometry, ConstraintPenalty, SymmetricObjectiveForm, MaximizeAssociation, PenalizeDisagreement, and ConstrainEqualScores; hard/bounded/quadratic LinearConstraint semantics; adjoint/marginal/cycle/hub/global-PSD certificate slots without overclaiming; ADT-backed objective records; and an executable partially aligned multiset association eigenmethod. Added 9 shared direct-sum laws plus linalg block laws. Verified warning-clean on JVM and Scala.js: linalg 44/44 each, multivar 273/273 each.
